name: IPE Universal Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Spokane, Washington, IPE Universal Inc. was established in 2007 and operates with a dual focus spanning both digital communications and sustainable energy. In the digital sphere, the company specializes in developing and bringing to market mobile Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) communication solutions and mobile advertising applications, with a particular presence in Malaysia and Hong Kong. Its offerings include a unique mobile marketing platform that empowers clients to display advertising banners on mobile devices. Furthermore, IPE Universal delivers software systems for mobile VoIP gateways and multimedia sharing gateways to its network of channel partners, private label partners, and direct customers. The company also provides MobiCAST, a location-aware mobile-web social network and microblogging service, along with the MobiREWARDS program tailored for advertisers. Beyond its digital ventures, IPE Universal Inc. extends its expertise to consulting services for the engineering and integration of solar photovoltaic (PV)-wind power generation systems. It also advises on power plants dedicated to producing biomass energy, utilizing feedstocks such as wood residues, oil palm stems, and fronds. Notably, these hybrid energy systems, encompassing solar PV-wind and solar PV-Biomass technologies, were previously marketed under the Aris brand when the company operated as Keynes Technology Co Ltd., a name it held until its rebranding to IPE Universal Inc. in May 2021.
